notes.title: v1.0.2 patch notes
notes.content:
This is a teeny-tiny patch :-)
Thank you all for your feedback!

- enabled VSync
- corrected reported typos
- fixed an unwinnable behavior in Level 7
- fixed issues with "Art camp" achievement 
- fixed issue with a wrong date on the calendar after Level 5
- replaces word "colored" with "colorful"

Cheers,
5am Games team
